anchors.label: Accession of Ahab, king of Israel
anchors.note: Root anchor for the Omride narratives. Under Thiele's chronology Ahab reigned 874-853 BCE; the end of his reign is pinned by the battle of Qarqar (853 BCE), where Shalmaneser III's Kurkh Monolith lists 'Ahab the Israelite' among the coalition kings.

anchors.label: Birth of Joseph, son of Jacob and Rachel
anchors.note: Root anchor for the Joseph story (Genesis 37-50), where the text counts time by Joseph's age. Genesis gives no date of its own: the year comes from the Masoretic numbers back from Solomon's temple (480 years to the Exodus, 430 years in Egypt), so it inherits the active scheme's date for Solomon and carries a margin of two centuries.

anchors.label: Birth of Jacob and Esau, sons of Isaac and Rebekah
anchors.note: Root anchor for the Jacob cycle (Genesis 25-36). Derived from Joseph's birth through the Masoretic ages (Jacob was 91 when Joseph was born), so it carries Joseph's margin of two centuries.

anchors.label: Birth of Isaac, son of Abraham and Sarah
anchors.note: Sixty years before Jacob's birth (Gen 25:26), in the same Masoretic chain.

anchors.label: Birth of Abram, son of Terah
anchors.note: Root anchor for the Abraham cycle (Genesis 11-25), where the text counts time by Abraham's and Sarah's ages: a hundred years before Isaac's birth (Gen 21:5).

anchors.label: The year the Flood began, Noah's six hundredth
anchors.note: Root anchor for Genesis 6-11. Counted from Abram's birth back through the ages of Gen 11; the margin also covers the reading that Terah was 130, not 70, at Abram's birth.

anchors.label: Creation, the first year of the world (Anno Mundi 1)
anchors.note: Root anchor for Genesis 1-5, by the ages of Gen 5 in the Masoretic text. It dates the text's own chronology, not the age of the earth; the Septuagint's ages give a different chronology, more than a thousand years longer.
